specs.Item Type Name: Insta360 GO 3S Retro Bundle (Special Edition)- Canvas White 64GB

features: Fresh Shots, Nostalgic Feel - Pair GO 3S with the Retro Viewfinder for a unique street shooting experience that blends modern tech with classic style.
Exclusive Retro Filters for a Film-like Shot - Built-in retro filters recreate film-style shots. Choose Positive or Negative Film for a nostalgic look straight out of this body camera.
1.4oz (39g) & Thumb Sized – A tiny, powerful pocket camera you can carry anywhere. Clip it, hang it, and capture everyday moments with ease.
4K Hands-Free POVs - Shoot hands-free in 4K with a wearable POV camera. Capture ultra-wide shots with less distortion, whether you’re walking, traveling, or exploring.
Mount Anywhere - Magnetic mini action camera design with versatile accessories. Attach to helmets, pets, or objects for creative angles other cameras can’t reach.
Double the Battery Life - The included Battery Pack increases the battery life to 76 mins. Stay ready to capture longer moments, trips, and daily adventures without interruption.
Versatile Vintage Vibes - Get a vintage look without editing. Apply film-style color profiles straight in-camera and shoot ready-to-share content instantly.
Smooth Shots - With three levels of FlowState Stabilization, you can shoot anywhere and still make magic. From sports to daily use, this body camera capture steady video without extra gear.
Seamless Editing - Tap to transfer and edit instantly. Use NFC to open the Insta360 app, preview clips, and create edits in seconds.
